camadas-para-cachos: A layered curly cut falling to just below the collarbones when the curls are dry. Long, rounded layers start at cheekbone level around the face and continue through the crown and back, removing bulk from the ends so the curls spring up and stack evenly instead of forming a triangle. Face-framing curls begin at the chin. Soft middle or slight side part, lift and volume at the crown and sides, a softly rounded perimeter with light, defined ends. Defined, bouncy, separated curl clumps with a frizz-free finish. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3A-3B curls.
corte-arredondado-cachos: A rounded curly cut that shapes the curls into a balanced, circular silhouette reaching the shoulders when dry. Graduated interior layers are cut shorter at the crown and top and progressively longer toward the perimeter, so the volume is evenly distributed from roots to ends, with no flat top and no wide triangular bulk at the bottom. Face-framing curls fall from the cheekbones to the jaw. Center part, full rounded volume at the crown and sides, ends soft and curved. Defined, springy curl clumps. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3B curls.
shaggy-cacheado: A curly shag reaching the shoulders when dry: short, choppy layers are concentrated at the crown and top of the head, creating a tall, rounded, voluminous top that tapers into lighter, thinner, piecey lengths around the nape and shoulders. Short curly curtain bangs fall at eyebrow-to-cheekbone length, softly parted in the center and blending into cheekbone-length face-framing curls. Lots of lift at the crown, airy, slightly undone, rock-inspired texture with separated, bouncy curl clumps. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3A-3B curls.
chanel-cacheado: A chin-length curly bob: when dry, the curls sit at chin-to-jaw level all around, the front and back roughly the same length, with a soft, rounded perimeter. Light internal layers remove bulk from the bottom so the shape is round and full rather than triangular, with volume at the crown and sides and curls framing the cheeks. Side or center part, nape covered by curls. Springy, defined, bouncy curl clumps and a playful, rounded silhouette. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3B curls.
long-bob-cacheado: A curly long bob (lob) that, when dry, falls between the shoulders and the collarbones, slightly longer in front than at the nape. Soft, long layers start at the chin to release the curls and keep the bottom from getting heavy, giving a rounded, balanced shape with volume at the crown and sides. Face-framing curls fall around the jawline. Deep side part or center part, curls resting on the tops of the shoulders, defined and bouncy, in soft separated clumps. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3A-3B curls.
black-power: A classic round afro: dense coily hair picked out and shaped into a full, symmetrical sphere around the whole head, extending evenly about 12 to 15 cm from the scalp at the top, sides and back, its lower edge reaching about the jawline at the sides and covering the nape. The outline is smooth and perfectly rounded, trimmed evenly, with a soft, fluffy, cloud-like surface where tiny coils are visible up close. Soft natural hairline at the forehead and temples. Tight 4B-4C coily texture, full, airy density.
big-chop: A big chop: a short natural curly crop where all straightened or chemically treated lengths have been cut off, leaving only fresh natural curls about 5 to 7 cm long, evenly cut into a soft, rounded shape that follows the head. When dry, the curls sit around the tops of the ears and the nape, with a few loose curls framing the forehead and slightly more length on top for gentle height. Healthy, springy, well-defined small curls with natural shine and density. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural tight 3C curls.
cacheado-longo-definido: Long, defined curly hair reaching the middle of the back when dry, with long, invisible layers that start at the chin so the curls cascade in even spirals without getting heavy or flat at the roots. Rounded U-shaped perimeter, face-framing curls starting at the cheekbones. Center part, lift at the crown, full body through the mid-lengths and ends. Every curl clump is well defined, uniform, glossy and elongated, as if styled with leave-in and finger-coiled, with minimal frizz. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3A-3B spiral curls.
cacheado-3b-definido: Natural type 3B curly hair reaching the shoulders to collarbones when dry: bouncy, springy ringlets about the width of a thick marker (around 2 cm in diameter), tightly spiraled and well defined from root to tip. Rounded layers through the crown and sides create a full, balanced, rounded shape with good root volume. Face-framing ringlets at the cheekbones, center part, glossy, clumped, uniform curls with minimal frizz, like a fresh wash-and-go with leave-in.
cacheado-3c-definido: Natural type 3C curly hair reaching the shoulders when dry: tight, dense corkscrew curls about the width of a pencil or a drinking straw (under 1 cm in diameter), packed closely together and well defined, as if finger-coiled. Rounded layers create a full, round, voluminous shape with lots of body at the crown and sides and natural shrinkage. Center part, face-framing coils at the cheeks, glossy, separated spirals with natural density and very little frizz.
cacheado-3a-definido: Natural type 3A curly hair reaching just below the collarbones when dry: large, loose, well-defined spiral curls about the width of a stick of sidewalk chalk (around 3 cm in diameter), forming clear S-shaped loops from just below the roots to the ends. Long, blended layers starting at the chin give movement and keep the volume balanced, with a softly rounded perimeter. Center or side part, gentle lift at the roots, shiny, separated, uniform curl clumps with minimal frizz, styled with leave-in for definition.
ondulado-2b-natural: Natural type 2B wavy hair reaching just below the collarbones when dry: well-defined, medium S-shaped waves beginning at about cheekbone level and continuing to the ends, with smoother roots and more pronounced bends through the mid-lengths. Blended layers starting at the jaw give movement and keep the waves from looking heavy, with a softly rounded perimeter and face-framing waves. Side or center part, soft volume, clumped, defined waves with light natural shine and minimal frizz, scrunched and air-dried.
ondulado-2c-natural: Natural type 2C wavy hair reaching below the collarbones when dry: deep, thick, pronounced S-waves that start close to the roots, with some loose spiral ringlets forming through the lengths and ends. Layers start at the chin to release weight and give a rounded, full shape with volume at the crown and sides. Face-framing waves at the cheekbones, center part, defined wave clumps with a little natural texture and soft shine, scrunched and diffused.
ondulado-2a-natural: Natural type 2A wavy hair reaching between the shoulder blades when dry: soft, loose, barely-there S-shaped waves that begin below the ears, with smooth, flat roots and bends that become more visible through the mid-lengths and ends. Long, soft layers starting at the chin, a softly rounded perimeter, center part, light movement and an airy, tousled, lived-in texture with soft natural shine.
crespo-4a-definido: Natural type 4A coily hair in a full, rounded shape that, with natural shrinkage, sits between the jaw and the shoulders: tight, springy S-patterned coils about the width of a crochet needle, densely packed and clearly defined in shiny, separated coil clumps, as if finger-coiled or styled as a wash-and-go with gel. Good height at the crown, fullness at the sides, evenly trimmed rounded outline. Center or side part, soft natural hairline, healthy moisture-rich sheen.
crespo-4c-longo: Long natural type 4C coily hair, gently stretched so its length shows, falling past the shoulders toward the armpits: extremely dense, tightly coiled strands with tiny, barely visible coil patterns, forming a big, soft, voluminous mass with a cotton-like, fluffy surface. Trimmed into a rounded, slightly elongated oval shape, full at the crown, sides and back, the lengths falling softly with their own weight. Center part, soft natural hairline, healthy soft sheen with visible fine texture.
crespo-4b-natural: Natural type 4B coily hair in a rounded, full shape that, with natural shrinkage, sits around jaw-to-shoulder level: tightly packed strands bent in sharp Z-shaped zigzags rather than spirals, forming soft, fluffy, cotton-like clumps with only loosely defined coils. Evenly trimmed rounded silhouette, airy volume all around, more height at the crown, soft natural hairline. Dense, plush texture with a soft, natural sheen.
devacut: A DevaCut: a dry, curl-by-curl cut that sculpts the curls into a soft, rounded, voluminous shape reaching just past the shoulders. Each curl is trimmed where it naturally sits, creating many short interior layers at the crown and top and longer curls underneath, so the curls stack on top of each other with big lift at the roots and a full, cloud-like crown. Face-framing curls at the cheekbones and chin, center part, rounded perimeter with no blunt line and no triangle. Defined, bouncy, separated curl clumps. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3B curls.
cacheado-com-franja: Curly hair reaching the shoulders to collarbones when dry, with a full curly fringe: a front section is cut so that, when dry, the bangs sit at or just above the eyebrows, falling forward over the forehead in soft, rounded curl clumps that blend at the temples into cheekbone-length face-framing curls. The rest is cut in rounded layers with volume at the crown and a soft, curved perimeter. Defined, springy, bouncy curls, playful and natural. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3B curls.
juba-cacheada: Big, voluminous curly hair like a full mane, reaching the collarbones to armpits when dry, with many layers cut throughout so the curls expand outward in every direction. Maximum lift at the roots and crown, wide, full sides extending well beyond the shoulders, and a generous rounded silhouette with curls framing the forehead, cheeks and jaw. Center or slightly off-center part, curls fluffed and separated for extra body yet still defined, bouncy and glossy. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural dense 3B-3C curls.
afro-volumoso: A big, free-form voluminous afro: dense coily hair worn loose and fluffed out into an extra-large, slightly oval silhouette that extends far beyond the head, wider than the shoulders and falling to about collarbone level at the sides. The outline is soft and organic rather than perfectly sculpted, with visible coil clumps and natural texture on the surface, a little more height at the crown and full volume at the sides and back. Soft natural hairline. Tight 4A-4C coily texture, abundant density, healthy natural sheen.
borboleta-cacheado: A curly butterfly cut reaching below the collarbones to the armpits when dry: short, voluminous layers start at the cheekbones and around the crown, forming a shorter, rounded top section that flows into longer, lighter layers through the back. Long curly face-framing pieces part in the center and sweep outward along the cheekbones and jaw like wings. Big lift at the crown, bouncy curls around the front, light, separated curl clumps at the ends. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3A-3B curls.
franja-cortina-cacheada: Curly hair reaching the collarbones when dry, with curly curtain bangs: a front section is cut so the curls, when dry, fall from a center part at cheekbone length, opening outward on both sides of the forehead and blending smoothly into jaw-length face-framing curls and the long layers behind. The center of the forehead stays partly visible. Soft rounded layers through the back, volume at the crown, defined, bouncy, separated curls. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3A-3B curls.
wolf-cut-cacheado: A curly wolf cut, a blended hybrid of shag and mullet reaching the shoulders at the back when dry. Heavy, short, choppy layers on top and at the crown create big rounded volume, while the sides are shorter and the back is left longer, thinner and wispy, falling over the nape and shoulders. Short, wispy curly bangs at eyebrow-to-cheekbone length blend into cheekbone-length face-framing curls. Textured, edgy, undone finish with bouncy, separated curl clumps. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3B curls.
twa-afro-curtinho: A TWA (teeny weeny afro): very short natural coily hair, about 2 to 4 cm long, cut evenly all over so it follows the round shape of the head in a neat, compact, slightly rounded silhouette. The hairline at the forehead, temples and nape is clean and natural, with the ears and neck fully uncovered. Dense, tightly coiled 4B-4C texture with visible tiny coils, slightly fluffed on top, with a soft natural sheen.
pixie-cacheado: A curly pixie cut: the sides and nape are cut short and tapered close to the head, uncovering the ears and neck, while the top and crown are left longer, about 6 to 9 cm, so the curls pile up into a soft, rounded volume on top. A few short curls fall forward onto the upper forehead as a loose curly fringe. Clean, neat outline around the ears and nape, more height and fullness at the crown. Springy, defined, glossy curls. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3B-3C curls.
afro-degrade: A tapered afro: natural coily hair cut short and graduated at the sides and nape, fading from about 1 cm just above the ears and neckline up to longer hair on top, where the coils are left about 6 to 10 cm long and shaped into a rounded, slightly raised crown. The silhouette is narrow at the sides and fuller on top, like a soft cone. Ears uncovered, clean, crisp outline at the nape and around the ears, dense, defined coils on top. Tight 4A-4C coily texture with natural sheen.
afro-puff: An afro puff: natural coily hair gathered and secured invisibly into one big, round, fluffy puff at the crown, toward the back of the top of the head. The sides and hairline are smoothed and brushed up neatly toward the puff, with soft, natural edges at the forehead and temples, and the puff itself is a large, full, soft sphere of coils clearly visible above and behind the head from the front. Tight 4A-4C coily texture, airy and defined on the surface, natural sheen.
abacaxi-pineapple: A curly pineapple updo: all the curls are gathered loosely and secured invisibly very high at the top front of the head, so they spill upward and forward like a fountain over the crown and down toward the forehead and sides. The back and sides are drawn up gently without being pulled flat, and a few loose curls escape around the temples and nape. Big height on top, bouncy, defined, separated curl clumps. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3B curls.
rezo-cut: A Rezo cut: a long, round curly shape reaching just below the collarbones when dry, with nearly even length all the way around and a soft, rounded perimeter. Long, continuous interior layers are cut on the curls to maximize volume at the roots and crown while keeping weight and length at the ends, so the silhouette is a full, balanced oval with no flat top and no triangle. Face-framing curls blend in from the chin. Center part, elongated, bouncy curls, uniform volume from root to tip. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3A-3B curls.
mullet-cacheado: A curly mullet: the top, crown and sides are cut short with choppy layers so the curls sit around ear level and form a rounded, voluminous top, while the back is left noticeably longer, falling in curls past the nape to the shoulders. A short, wispy curly fringe at eyebrow length blends into cheekbone-length side curls. Strong contrast between the short front and the long back, an edgy, retro-modern, textured finish with bouncy, separated curls. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3B curls.
corte-v-cacheado: A long curly V-cut: when dry, the sides fall below the collarbones and the length increases toward the back, where the curls form a soft V point between the shoulder blades. Long layers start at the chin and follow the V, lightening the ends so the curls spiral freely, with face-framing curls at the cheekbones. Center part, volume at the crown, cascading, defined, bouncy curls. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3A-3B curls.
afro-esticado-blowout: A blowout afro: natural coily hair stretched with a blow-dryer so the coils are elongated and loosened, giving a huge, soft, airy, cloud-like volume with a smooth, fluffy, brushed surface and almost no visible coil pattern. Shaped into a large, rounded, slightly oval silhouette reaching about the collarbones at the sides, with lots of height at the crown and fullness all around, in a 1970s-inspired look. Soft natural hairline, smooth stretched roots, healthy sheen.
cacheado-lateral-raspada: A curly side undercut: one side of the head, from the temple to above and behind the ear, is shaved to about 3 mm with a clean, sharp edge, while the rest of the hair is left long, reaching the shoulders when dry, and swept over to the opposite side from a deep side part. The curls pile up voluminously on top and fall over the other side, framing it from the cheekbone to the jaw. Defined, bouncy curls in contrast with the neat shaved area. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3B curls.
cacheado-assimetrico: An asymmetrical curly bob with a deep side part: one side is cut longer, falling in curls between the jawline and the shoulder and sweeping across the forehead above the brow, while the opposite side is cut shorter, around the earlobe, with curls sitting close to the head. The back is graduated shorter at the nape and rounded. Volume concentrated on the longer side, bouncy, defined, separated curls, bold and modern. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3B curls.
afro-com-franja: A rounded afro with coily bangs: dense coily hair shaped into a full, rounded silhouette at jaw-to-shoulder level, with a front section cut shorter so a thick fringe of coils falls forward over the forehead to just above the eyebrows, blending at the temples into the fullness of the sides. Even volume at the crown and sides, soft rounded outline, defined, springy coils with a fluffy, airy surface. Tight 4A-4C coily texture, natural sheen.
dois-puffs: Two afro puffs: natural coily hair parted straight down the center from the forehead to the nape and gathered into two round, fluffy puffs, one on each side of the top of the head, symmetrical and secured invisibly. Each puff is a full, soft sphere of coils, and the hair between the hairline and the puffs is smoothed neatly toward them, with soft natural edges. Tight 4A-4C coily texture, airy, defined surface, natural sheen.
ouidad-cut: An Ouidad carve-and-slice cut reaching the collarbones when dry: bulk is removed from inside the hair by carving out curls at different depths, so the curls nest and interlock like puzzle pieces. The result is a controlled, contoured, teardrop-shaped silhouette, slimmer at the sides near the ears, with soft body at the crown and no wide triangle. Curls fall in long, cohesive, well-defined spiral clumps with less frizz and less puff. Side or center part, face-framing curls from the chin. If the hair is already curly or coily, keep its own natural curl pattern; otherwise create natural 3B curls.
moicano-crespo: A coily mohawk: both sides of the head are shaved or faded very short, about 2 mm above the ears up to the temples, with clean edges, while a strip about 8 cm wide down the center of the head, from the forehead to the nape, is left long, about 10 to 15 cm, and shaped into a tall, rounded crest of dense coils, highest at the crown. Tight 4A-4C coily texture with defined coils and natural sheen, bold and striking.
frohawk: A frohawk with no shaved areas: the hair on both sides is smoothed back and up toward the center, sleek and close to the head and secured invisibly, while the hair along the center from the forehead to the nape is fluffed into a tall, voluminous ridge of coils, like a soft afro mohawk, highest at the crown and slightly lower at the front and back. Tight 4A-4C coily texture, defined, airy coils on the crest, natural sheen.
